scope: Read-only review of independent raw-source premises and evaluator integration, plus bounded authored mutations of saved development fixtures. No original 86-case evaluation and no 24-case holdout evaluation.
provenance: Shared-workspace non-blind implementation review after source discovery and runtime freeze. The fixtures are development artifacts, not untouched natural-language test material.

findings.root_cause: The checker requires the donor's own tanwin receipt to occur in the selected terminal-pair receipts. The compiler selects the first witness of each vowel family and the first tanwin observation separately. A later tanwin is valid evidence for the same directly equal nominal group.
findings.required_correction: Remove only receipt-subset membership. Retain independently re-read own tanwin, identical donor/recipient template and lexical traits, opposite POS, two terminal vowel families, and complete transferred pair receipts.

findings.scope_limit: Acceptance is established for validate_sense_witness alone after raw-receipt rebinding. No runtime or complete-evaluator false acceptance is claimed; production replay remains a separate mandatory gate.

review_support: The helper imports no production lexical compiler or reader.
Raw byte spans, source hashes, locators and exclusions are independently replayed.
Name identity remains conditional on supplied naming premises and the selected attested reading; explicit target shadda must be supported, and homonymous context candidates are retained.
The nominal correspondence compares direct source templates and derivational traits, known singular number, gender, lemma and root; it does not acquire POS equivalence, target roles or world truth.
The hasiba witness requires the fully written active form حَسِبَ, the pinned Mukhtar al-Sihah interval and raw lexical support; standalone embedded assertions are forbidden.
Both evaluators invoke the source helper for exposed new witnesses and separately require runtime replay.
limits: Full compiled inventory and lexical-ID recomputation are intentionally delegated to the separate runtime replay; the source helper does not constitute independent reimplementation of the entire compiler.

Policy and law hash strings inside some receipts are checked for shape, while the selected primary passages are fixed independently. This review does not claim those hash strings alone authenticate a rule.
Pinned text authentication establishes identity of the selected digital transmission, not diplomatic manuscript accuracy or universal linguistic validity.
No additional runtime source, gold expectation or historical evidence was changed.
evidence_preservation: Original helper bytes are preserved adjacent to this receipt; before/after verification will be recorded separately.
